selection_notes: Excluded personal CV sites, Reddit applicant posts, and social-profile scraping.
No university sample is asserted to be licensed for ML training merely because it is publicly viewable.
The generated resumes have no names, contacts, school prestige signals, or protected demographic characteristics.
Majors and academic stages are not relevance labels: teacher grading must assess demonstrated, job-relevant evidence.
The online catalogs establish that broader academic and career-stage coverage is feasible; they do not establish model quality.
